name: Color Catch
description: Photo color game GA42 for Rokid glasses: six rounds call a color (red, yellow, blue, green, orange, purple); the player photographs a real object whose main color matches, and a host LLM image judge answers VERDICT YES/NO with a reason. Swipe switches unattempted rounds, nod logs a non-scoring appeal. Camera only, photos judged in memory, never saved.
